work.author: PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA
work.description: The act creates Carlo Vizzardelli cardinal and reserves one in pectore. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF23325-23326 reads: HABITA IN CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE XVII! lANUARII ANNO MDCCCXLYIII Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
